import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg

M = np.array([[2, 1, 0],
              [1, 3, 1],
              [0, 1, 2]])
A = M @ M.T + np.eye(3)

L = linalg.cholesky(A, lower=True)

cholesky_check = np.allclose(L @ L.T, A)

b = np.array([1, 2, 3])

y = linalg.solve_triangular(L, b, lower=True)
x_cholesky = linalg.solve_triangular(L.T, y, lower=False)

x_scipy = linalg.solve(A, b)

P_lu, L_lu, U_lu = linalg.lu(A)

lu_check = P_lu @ (L_lu @ U_lu)

U_svd, s_svd, Vt_svd = np.linalg.svd(A)
condition = s_svd[0] / s_svd[-1]

print(f"Cholesky factor L:\n{L}")
print(f"Cholesky solve: {x_cholesky}")
print(f"SciPy solve: {x_scipy}")
print(f"LU decomposition verified: {np.allclose(lu_check, A)}")
print(f"Condition number: {condition:.4f}")
